scope: The three ordinary server call sites reach PublicPolicy::id through resource_profile. Other profile domains remain separate; unchanged bodies are not a claim of complete callgraph coverage.
work_arithmetic_lines_1_to_100:
1: //! Separate opt-in resource profile for exact mathematical-fact reuse.
2: //!
3: //! Default clients and servers retain the original r14 profile and complete
4: //! verifier for valid/new proofs. Ordinary classical service startup may reuse
5: //! only previously completed mathematical refusals through its bounded cache.
6: //! This owner is fresh and empty, volatile and local to one explicitly configured
7: //! server. Its setup allocation is not a guest CPU charge. All actual request
8: //! lookup/comparison/reconstruction/publication work runs inside the original
9: //! paid worker interval, including contention fallback and cancellation tails.
10: //! No cache outcome grants native execution or additional completion priority.
11: use super::*;
12: use trnm_crypto_primitives::pon_work::arithmetic_facts::{
13:     ArithmeticFactCache, ArithmeticObservation, ArithmeticPublication, MAX_ARITHMETIC_FACT_SLOTS,
14:     MAX_ARITHMETIC_FACT_SOFTWARE_BYTES,
15: };
16: 
17: impl PublicPolicy {
18:     /// This is a separate signed profile, never a replacement identity for r14.
19:     /// The original budgets, absolute deadlines and completion guard are bound
20:     /// through the original profile; only the explicitly named arithmetic path
21:     /// differs. It confers no production/WAN qualification.
22:     pub fn arithmetic_facts_id(self) -> Hash {
23:         hash(
24:             b"public-protected-profile-v3-arithmetic-facts-v1",
25:             &[
26:                 &self.id(),
27:                 b"fresh-empty-server-local-owner/exact-challenge-and-canonical-whole-A-B-bytes/completed-trace-and-optional-completed-product-only/no-verdict-task-target-state-or-authorization-cache/current-grammar-field-task-target-and-trace-product-claims-every-call/original-cooperative-cancellation/no-publish-on-returned-cancel/bounded-final-compare-publish-tail/try-lock-no-wait-contention-does-actual-raw-math/fixed64-slots-round-robin-no-growth/software-objects-not-RSS/original-actual-thread-CPU-owner-includes-all-math-cache-work/no-added-credit-deadline-or-completion-identity/independent-per-request-arithmetic-observation",
28:                 &(MAX_ARITHMETIC_FACT_SLOTS as u64).to_le_bytes(),
29:                 &(MAX_ARITHMETIC_FACT_SOFTWARE_BYTES as u64).to_le_bytes(),
30:             ],
31:         )
32:     }
33: }
34: 
35: impl PublicServer {
36:     /// Explicit trusted-local setup, before serving. Each enabled server starts
37:     /// with 64 empty slots; callers cannot insert facts or reset this owner.
38:     /// Enabling does not replace the shared CPU account or mint startup credit.
39:     /// Original constructors remain raw unless this method is explicitly called.
40:     pub fn with_arithmetic_facts(mut self) -> Result<Self> {
41:         ensure(
42:             !self.identity.is_pq()
43:                 && self.arithmetic_facts.is_none()
44:                 && self.w1_rejection_cache.is_none()
45:                 && !self.native_growth,
46:             "PUBLIC_ARITHMETIC_FACTS_ALREADY_ENABLED",
47:         )?;
48:         self.arithmetic_facts = Some(ArithmeticFactCache::new(MAX_ARITHMETIC_FACT_SLOTS)?);
49:         Ok(self)
50:     }
51: 
52:     pub fn resource_profile(&self) -> Hash {
53:         if self.identity.is_pq() {
54:             self.policy.pq_history_id()
55:         } else if self.native_growth {
56:             self.policy.growth_id()
57:         } else if self.arithmetic_facts.is_some() {
58:             self.policy.arithmetic_facts_id()
59:         } else {
60:             self.policy.id()
61:         }
62:     }
63: 
64:     /// Retained Rust object-storage charge for this volatile arithmetic owner.
65:     /// Does not include allocator metadata, ordinary per-call verifier workspace,
66:     /// returned values or optional request-observer rows; never an RSS claim.
67:     pub fn arithmetic_facts_software_bytes(&self) -> Option<usize> {
68:         self.arithmetic_facts
69:             .as_ref()
70:             .map(ArithmeticFactCache::software_bytes)
71:     }
72: }

74: /// Explicit client for the separately signed arithmetic profile. There is no
75: /// fallback to raw or another profile. The original client and its optional
76: /// absolute-deadline entry keep their exact expected r14 profile and behavior.
77: pub fn call_public_protected_v3_with_arithmetic_facts(
78:     address: SocketAddr,
79:     request: &Request,
80:     settings: &Settings,
81:     pinned_server: &str,
82:     caller: &DevelopmentIdentity,
83:     policy: PublicPolicy,
84:     outer_deadline: Option<Instant>,
85: ) -> (Result<PublicReply>, PublicClientMetrics) {
86:     call_public_protected_v3_with_profile(
87:         address,
88:         request,
89:         settings,
90:         pinned_server,
91:         caller,
92:         (policy, ClientProfile::ArithmeticFacts),
93:         outer_deadline,
94:     )
95: }
